stories.title: Shaun and the Shop That Sold Clouds
stories.outro: See you next time in Sunny Meadow!

youtube.title: Shaun and the Shop That Sold Clouds | Sunny Meadow
youtube.description: Shaun's first cloud for sale changed shape before opening. Gigi watched a cloudy rabbit become a long spoon. A playful adventure with a funny ending. #SunnyMeadow #DreamyDiscoveries

lines.text: Shaun's first cloud for sale changed shape before opening.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Gigi watched a cloudy rabbit become a long spoon.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: My rabbit-shaped cloud has become different merchandise!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: It now looks excellent for stirring enormous imaginary soup.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Shaun wanted to open a pretend cloud shop.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He had made a small sign beside the meadow bench.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Clouds for pretend sale! Choose a favorite shape!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I would like something fluffy enough for a giant pillow.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Shaun pointed to a cloud above the nearby tree.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It looked like a pillow with two uneven corners.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One giant pillow, fresh from the afternoon sky.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: How do I carry it home from up there?
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Shaun offered an empty basket beneath the drifting cloud.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Gigi held its handle while he inspected the sky.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Perhaps it will float down into your shopping basket.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: It appears to be shopping in the other direction.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Can Shaun really own a cloud in the sky?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Shaun pointed to a smaller cloud beside the first.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Gigi watched it spread into a feathery little streak.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: This one might fit into a smaller shopping bag.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: It is getting thinner while we discuss the wrapping.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Shaun tried drawing a boundary around the sky with his paws.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Every cloud ignored his very official imaginary shelves.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Please stay in your proper sections, fluffy customers!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I think your shelves might need to be as big as the sky.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Gigi asked whether everyone could still watch the clouds.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Shaun looked beyond his small pretend shop sign.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Of course. These are pretend sales, not real ones.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Then I shall admire mine without carrying it away.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Shaun offered a cloud-watching tour from their little bench.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Gigi chose the changing spoon above the meadow tree.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: That cloud is becoming a surprisingly tall giraffe.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: A fine choice. It has excellent taste in long necks.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: The giraffe-shaped cloud stretched into a wavy ribbon.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Shaun adjusted the imaginary label with great seriousness.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Your giraffe has become a scarf at no extra charge.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I have never owned such an energetic imaginary purchase.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: What could their pretend shop hand to a visitor?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Shaun drew the scarf cloud on a scrap of paper.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He offered the picture instead of the changing sky.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Here is something your shopping basket can actually carry.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: It fits wonderfully, and it has stopped changing shape.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Gigi drew a pillow cloud for Shaun's little display.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: They set the two paper pictures beside the shop sign.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Now visitors can choose a drawing of their favorite.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: And the real clouds can keep going wherever they like.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: They admired a new little cloud above the meadow.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It looked round enough for an imaginary biscuit.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One biscuit cloud, with absolutely no crumbs included!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Then it is not suitable for my real snack.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Shaun packed away the drawings when their game ended.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Gigi looked at his woolly, very cloud-shaped middle.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Do you have one final fluffy cloud for sale?
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: I am the shopkeeper, not the remaining stock.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Gigi gave the woolly shopkeeper a warm little smile.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Shaun lifted the sign beside his very ordinary sheep feet.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: This cloud can walk home after closing time.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: An excellent feature. None of the others had feet.
lines.speaker: friend
